passages.text: Learn how to use Claude Code to build your own AI social media manager in minutes. In this video, I’ll walk you through setting up Claude Code and the exact prompts to use to write content in your brand voice, generate visuals, and post to social media. If you want to save time, stay consistent, and leverage AI agents like a pro, this step-by-step tutorial will show you exactly how to do it.
## Prompt 1 - AI Agent Social Media Manager
Highly recommend following the Youtube tutorial to set things up properly, including installing Visual Studio Code, installing Claude Code, and opening a project directory.
